spriteComponent.name: Sprite
spriteComponent.event: local monsterId = element("MonsterID"):GetInt() if monsterId == 0 then component("visible"):SetInt(0) else local monsterData = game.getMonsterData(monsterId) component("spriteName"):SetString("gfx/breeding/"..monsterData:portrait()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.48*game.menuScaleX()) end component("layer"):SetString("MidPopUps")
